translation:
<ins>Ten-Ingredient Ginseng and Perilla Decoction (十味參蘇飲)</ins>
Ginseng (人參), perilla (紫蘇), pinellia (半夏), poria (茯苓), tangerine peel (陳皮), platycodon (桔梗), peucedanum (前胡), pueraria (葛根), bitter orange (枳殼, each one qian), licorice (甘草, five fen)
With the guiding herb two slices of ginger, decoct in water and take.
